title: Retrospective Clinical-Laboratory Data Analysis of Neuroborreliosis in Northern Rhineland-Palatinate/ Hessen
summary:
The aim of this study is to identify specific findings in cerebrospinal fluid and blood samples in different clinical presentations of Lyme-Disease with neurological manifestation, transmitted by tick bites. 
With this information, we aim to provide faster, more broadly available and less cost intensive diagnostical tools.

interventions.name: In this observational study CSF- and blood-sample constellations in patients with clinical manifestation of Neuroborrelioses were examined.
